description_en: Creates a class by calling CreateClass. The class can be used for scenarios such as student learning and workplace training, and provides features such as co-streaming, live streaming, whiteboard, and chat
description_zh: 调用CreateClass创建课程。可用于学生上课，职场培训等场景，包含连麦、直播、白板、聊天等功能
kebab_example: aliyun imp create-class --app-id 7m000q --title ClassTitle001 --create-user-id as0000hs --create-nickname nickname001 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateClass

parameters.help_en: The application ID of the user, which is generated when you create an application in the console. The ID consists of lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The class title. Chinese and English characters are supported. The maximum length is 32 characters
parameters.help_zh: 课程标题，支持中英文，最大长度32个字符
parameters.name: title

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the creator. Only letters and digits are supported. The maximum length is 36 characters
parameters.help_zh: 创建人用户ID，仅支持英文和数字，最大长度36个字符
parameters.name: create_user_id

parameters.help_en: The nickname of the creator. Chinese and English characters are supported. The maximum length is 32 characters
parameters.help_zh: 创建人用户昵称，支持中英文，最大长度32个字符
parameters.name: create_nickname

Result.description_en: The result of creating the class

ClassId.description_en: The unique identifier of the class

ConfId.description_en: The co-streaming conference ID. You can use this ID to join an RTC conference and retrieve conference details
ConfId.description_zh: 连麦会议ID。可用于RTC入会，获取会议详情

CreateUserId.description_en: The user ID of the creator

LiveId.description_en: The live streaming ID. You can use this ID to query live streaming details and pass it as a parameter when calling live streaming-related operations on the client
LiveId.description_zh: 直播ID。可用于查询直播详情，和端上调用直播相关接口时作为参数传入

RoomId.description_en: The room ID. You can use this ID to query room details and pass it as a parameter when integrating with the client SDK
RoomId.description_zh: 房间ID。可用于查询房间详情信息，和端上SDK接入时作为参数传入

Status.description_en:
The class status. Valid values:
0: not started
1: in progress
2: ended
Status.description_zh:
课程状态。取值：
0：未开始
1：上课中
2：已下课
Status.title_en: 课堂状态，0:未开始 1:上课中 2:已下课。
Status.title_zh: 课堂状态，0:未开始 1:上课中 2:已下课。

WhiteboardId.description_en: The whiteboard ID. You can use this ID to query whiteboard information and pass it as a parameter when integrating with the whiteboard SDK on the client
WhiteboardId.description_zh: 白板ID。可用于查询白板信息，和端上接入白板SDK时作为参数传入

WhiteboardRecordId.description_en: The whiteboard recording ID. You can use this ID to retrieve and play back whiteboard recording content on the client
WhiteboardRecordId.description_zh: 白板录制记录ID。可用于端上获取白板录制内容并播放

Result.title_en: API请求的返回结果结构体。
Result.title_zh: API请求的返回结果结构体。
